comments.label: Bug fix
comments.note: Prices are floats in the stock file, so summing them drifted (`0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3`). Totals now use `Decimal`.

comments.label: Bug fix
comments.note: Converting through `str` keeps the price as written (`Decimal(0.1)` would carry the float's binary error).

comments.label: Behavior change
comments.note: `restock` used to **overwrite** the quantity. Callers pass the number of units received, so it now adds them.

comments.label: Behavior change
comments.note:
An unknown name used to be ignored silently, so a typo lost the restock. It now raises.

The early `return` also stops after the first match.

comments.label: Robustness
comments.note: Without an explicit encoding, `open` uses the platform default, which is not UTF-8 everywhere.

comments.label: Docs
comments.note: Describes the new `restock` behavior and the decimal totals.

comments.label: Example data
comments.note: A new sample file: these two prices sum to `0.30000000000000004` as floats.

general.title: Not changed
general.note: `report` still prints quantities only; adding prices there is a separate change.

general: Tests for `restock` are not part of this demo.
